title: Seagrove Beach "Sunset Serenity" 26 Beachside Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Lakefront property on Eastern Lake- Gulf views- Shared dock- 1.5 Miles from Seaside- Private heated pool and swim spa *Pool heating is available for $40/day October 1-May 1- 5 adult bikes- Grill- EV Charging - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Savor a dreamy 30A getaway at Sunset Serenity in Seagrove Beach. Hosting up to 18 guests, this beautiful 5-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom lakefront home offers all the slow-paced charm of Seagrove. Enjoy paddleboarding or kayaking on Eastern Lake and strolling to the beach—only 3 minutes away—for sunbathing and seashell hunting. With a private heated pool, sitting spa, and sprawling lake views, guests have everything needed for a luxurious and leisurely escape.Crafted for contemporary coastal living, the first-level great room features woven accents, shiplap detailing, and tile flooring—all in soothing shades of white and gray to reflect the warm sunlight. The fully equipped kitchen boasts high-end appliances and ample counter space, including a 4-stool breakfast bar for quiet mornings gathered over coffee. Savor home-cooked meals together at the 2 spacious dining tables, collectively seating 16. The living space’s matching slip-covered loveseats and plush armchair frame a Smart TV for convenient entertainment. On the sheltered patio, relax in the soft breeze of the overhead fan and take in the lake view at the 6-person table. A few steps lead down to the pool area, complete with a grill and outdoor shower. Recline on the cushioned loungers, take a refreshing swim, or soak in the sitting spa. A guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and a private bathroom offers cozy accommodations, alongside a queen sleeper sofa in the living space.On the second level, find 2 primary bedrooms, each with a king bed, private bathroom, and shared balcony, as well as 1 guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and 1 bunk room with 1 full-over-full bed and 1 full trundle.Relax with loved ones in the top-level lounge space, featuring stunning lake views, an enormous sectional, 2 couches, a 4-seat table, and a Smart TV. A convenient kitchenette boasting a beverage fridge makes it easy to grab a drink to sip on the balcony’s Adirondack chairs. For additional accommodations, there is a queen Murphy bed in the lounge.A carefree Seagrove Beach escape awaits at Sunset Serenity. Effortlessly explore with parking for 3 vehicles, or cruise the Timpoochee Trail on the 5 provided adult bikes. Beach access is a 3-minute stroll away, at the end of Beachside Drive. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Jacuzzi Tub- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed and Full Trundle, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Additional Living Area: Queen Murphy Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only* The boat lift is not for guest use.* There is ongoing construction on the same block
